integrity: The infinite-lattice theorem is proved analytically from the exact tridiagonal Green kernel and an M-matrix argument. The finite periodic witness is verified by exact rational inversion. Finite checks corroborate displayed identities and do not substitute for the infinite-lattice proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp if-and-only-if classification is for the translation-invariant infinite one-dimensional lattice and one backward-Euler step. A four-point periodic calculation supplies a finite counterexample, but exact thresholds for every finite grid, boundary closures, multidimensional schemes, variable coefficients, nonlinear diffusion, and Crank-Nicolson are not classified.
title: One twelfth is the sharp positivity-recovery threshold for backward Euler on the classical fourth-order compact heat operator
